purpose: Allow the Lexicon Learner to use public dictionaries, thesauruses, encyclopedias, and style/reference sources for understanding word meaning and usage without copying protected expression.
rule: Reference sources educate the Framework; they do not become article, newsletter, or Creator Desk text.
transformRule: Reference sources inform understanding only; never copy definitions, examples, usage notes, encyclopedia sentences, or source phrasing.

allowedReferenceTypes.use: Understand definition range, part of speech, connotation, register, and usage boundaries.
Compare related words and choose precise alternatives based on tone and evidence certainty.
Understand concepts, historical context, entities, institutions, and domain terminology.
Understand grammar, clarity, attribution, punctuation, and plain-language principles.

prohibitedUses: Do not copy usage notes, encyclopedia passages, or reference-source phrasing.
Do not store reference-source wording as a writing template.
Do not imitate a reference source or publisher style.
Do not use reference sources as a substitute for evidence in a news story.
memoryTransform: Extract concept-level meaning in original CE wording.
Store neutral usage guidance, tone guidance, and avoid-confusion rules.
Separate factual evidence from vocabulary/style learning.
Track whether reference-informed word choices improve first-pass acceptance and reduce repetition.
Prefer precise, reader-clear words over rare words when the story needs direct reporting.
lexiconLearnerResponsibilities: Map words to story context, evidence certainty, tone, and reader clarity.
Recommend alternatives only when they improve precision or reduce repetition.
Flag words whose meaning, legal implication, or certainty level does not match the evidence.
Feed improved usage guidance to Writer, Publishing Editor, Validator Mentor, and Evolution Engine.
